item.title: Shawnee Parks and Recreation
item.description: Hey there, Shawnee! Did you hear any report from the official Ground Hog last Monday? Here in Oklahoma, we never know what the weather will do, and I’m not sure any ground hogs do either! Cold or warm, the Shawnee Parks and Recreation Department will do our best to serve our community. Our first ever Cabin Fever Karaoke Night was a success and fun for folks of all ages! We want to say “Thanks” to all who came either to sing or enjoy.
